name: Family Pension Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
benefit: - **Pension Amount:** ₹500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pension, whichever is higher.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be the spouse (husband/wife) of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been receiving a pension from the Board at the time of death.
